mapper.sql: SELECT o.id, o.customer_id, c.name AS company, o.name, o.owner_member_id, u.display_name AS owner_name, o.stage, o.status, o.amount, o.probability, o.expected_close_date, COALESCE(o.attributes ->> 'forecastCategory', 'PIPELINE') AS forecast_category, o.attributes ->> 'nextStep' AS next_step, o.close_reason, o.stage_changed_at, o.updated_at, o.version FROM opportunity o JOIN customer c ON c.organization_id = o.organization_id AND c.id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN organization_member m ON m.organization_id = o.organization_id AND m.id = o.owner_member_id LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE o.organization_id = #{org} AND o.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_count, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount), 0) AS pipeline_amount, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount * COALESCE(o.probability, 0) / 100.0), 0) AS weighted_amount, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.stage_changed_at < CAST(#{now} AS timestamptz) - INTERVAL '14 days') AS stalled_count FROM opportunity o JOIN customer c ON c.organization_id = o.organization_id AND c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.organization_id = #{org} AND o.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND o.status = 'OPEN'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer WHERE organization_id = #{org} AND id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM organization_member WHERE organization_id = #{org} AND id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO opportunity (id, organization_id, customer_id, owner_member_id, name, amount, currency, probability, expected_close_date, attributes, created_at, updated_at, stage_changed_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{org}, #{input.customerId}, #{input.ownerMemberId}, #{input.name}, #{input.amount}, 'CNY', #{input.probability}, #{input.expectedCloseDate}, jsonb_build_object('forecastCategory', CAST(#{input.forecastCategory} AS text), 'nextStep', CAST(#{input.nextStep} AS text)), #{now}, #{now}, #{now})
mapper.update: UPDATE opportunity SET name = #{input.name}, owner_member_id = #{input.ownerMemberId}, amount = #{input.amount}, probability = #{input.probability}, expected_close_date = #{input.expectedCloseDate}, attributes = attributes || jsonb_build_object('forecastCategory', CAST(#{input.forecastCategory} AS text), 'nextStep', CAST(#{input.nextStep} AS text)), updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE organization_id = #{org} AND id = #{id} AND version = #{input.version} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'OPEN'

UPDATE opportunity SET stage = #{input.stage}, status = CASE WHEN #{input.stage} IN ('WON', 'LOST') THEN #{input.stage} ELSE 'OPEN' END, probability = #{probability}, close_reason = #{input.reason}, closed_at = CASE WHEN #{input.stage} IN ('WON', 'LOST') THEN CAST(#{now} AS timestamptz) ELSE NULL END, stage_changed_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE organization_id = #{org} AND id = #{id} AND version = #{input.version} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'OPEN'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO opportunity_event (id, organization_id, opportunity_id, actor_member_id, from_stage, to_stage, summary, created_at) VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), #{org}, #{id}, #{actor}, #{from}, #{to}, #{summary}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT e.id, u.display_name AS actor_name, e.from_stage, e.to_stage, e.summary, e.created_at FROM opportunity_event e JOIN organization_member m ON m.organization_id = e.organization_id AND m.id = e.actor_member_id JOIN app_user u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE e.organization_id = #{org} AND e.opportunity_id = #{id} ORDER BY e.created_at DESC, e.id DESC LIMIT 100
